competencies.name: system_design
competencies.evidence_quote: I used a threading.Lock around the shared jobs dict so only one thread mutates state at a time, and _prune_jobs runs on a timer thread that walks the dict and evicts anything older than a TTL

competencies.name: technical_depth
competencies.evidence_quote: The five layers were: input sanitization (strip prompt injection patterns), a retrieval-time relevance filter, an output toxicity classifier, a citation-grounding check that rejects ungrounded claims, and a final rate-limiter for abuse patterns.
competencies.reasoning: Strong technical maturity in RAG pipeline architecture and performance optimization; the insight to run toxicity checks in parallel with generation indicates practical production experience.

competencies.name: problem_solving

competencies.name: communication

competencies.reasoning: Clear, direct communication of technical requirements for human-in-the-loop features; bridges the gap between backend capabilities and UX needs effectively.
